scope: evidence-preserving 5000-document, eight-claim dense encoder resource screen; not full-corpus effectiveness evidence
decision: Retain the 0.6B full-corpus latency-profile encoder; the sampled gate does not justify a full 4B rebuild.
boundaries: The sampler retains every gold-evidence row for the evaluated claims but is not the full 1,208,827-document corpus.
Only eight claims are evaluated, so this is a resource-selection screen rather than an independent quality claim.
Restricted inputs, predictions, embeddings and model caches remain on Spartan.
